title: CmdPal: Add a new tray icon menu

proposed_comments.body:
### Normalize duplicate saved tray pins

**Severity:** `medium`

If the saved tray pins contain the same provider/command pair twice and that command is available, refresh shows it once, but `Reorder` consumes an entry for each saved occurrence. After a drag, saving the new order throws, so `SaveOrder` sets `HasLoadError` and the reordered pins are not persisted. Could the saved list be deduplicated when it is loaded, keeping the first occurrence?

```suggestion
        init => _commands = value?.Distinct().ToImmutableList() ?? [];
```

confidence.rationale: The product source-generated settings test and mocked viewmodel reproduce the conditional failure, and the literal candidate passes; only externally modified or preexisting duplicate data is established, not normal UI creation.

proposed_comments.title: Normalize duplicate saved tray pins
